items: The melodies dance: the lead plays a catchy riff that repeats every bar and answers itself every fourth, in the styles of trance, hip-hop, witch house and bright electro-pop

Twelve new lead sounds to play them on: trance supersaws, plucks and stabs, a dusty electric piano, lo-fi keys and a breathy flute, a dark saw, a music box and a low choir, bright arpeggio synths, glassy bells and an airy synth voice
The singer sometimes sings a short, high hook over and over, and in the haunted breakdowns she sings the tune slowly before the drop plays it as a riff
The basslines step into each chord change, change over four bars, lock in with the kick drum and slide between notes in the hip-hop and witch-house styles
The house bass sits lower and rounder, moves smoothly from chord to chord, leaves the kick drum room, and changes its rhythm every few bars instead of bouncing on every offbeat
